text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak agree on setting up a joint committee to strengthen relations.
- United Arab Emirates and Morocco to establish joint company for trade, investment and tourism.
- Interior and agriculture ministers preside over first interministerial committee for promotion of agriculture sector.
- Moroccan team visits Kuwait and Saudi Arabia to seek Arab investment.
- Insufficient rains and hasty liberalisation of wheat, sugar and edible oil imports raise fears of farmers.
- Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro expected on a two-day visit to Morocco starting on Tuesday.
- King Hassan to inaugurate a $851 million reservoir with a capacity of four billion cubic metres.
- Banks to cut two percentage points on loan interest to small and medium-sized firms.
